context: Clinical referral and handover quality layer connecting AI extraction, deterministic validation, conflict detection, referral quality scoring, and mandatory clinician approval.

typography.body: Inter or DM Sans, text-base, leading-relaxed
typography.mono: JetBrains Mono for data, scores, and clinical codes

surface_strategies.header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200 sticky z-50
surface_strategies.card: bg-white border border-slate-200/80 rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6
surface_strategies.modal: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 p-6

instructions_to_main_agent: Connect the Emergent frontend to the real ClinBridge backend API source of truth. Preserve existing UI structure, ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes, support real referral creation, extraction display, deterministic validation, conflict detection, quality score, SBAR handover editing, clinician approval, and referral tracking without mocking backend logic.
universal_guidelines: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a data-testid attribute.
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds without blur/scrim for headers or overlays.
Respect system contrast and accessibility standards.
Ensure error, loading, and empty states are gracefully handled.
